summary_1line: Yudhishthira seeks further guidance as Dhritarashtra prepares to retire to the forest and gathers the people to request permission and make final charitable gifts.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged blind king Dhritarashtra stands before a vast assembly of citizens and Brahmanas, announcing his decision to retire to the forest with Gandhari.
Gandhari speaks to Dhritarashtra seated in his chamber, urging him to seek Yudhishthira’s permission before departing for the forest.
